paragraphs.text:
“Greek sponge divers have recovered a puzzling device off the 
island of Karpathos, a small island between Crete and Turkey. 
The device is a mechanism believed to be thousands of years old, 
yet bright and untarnished, as though made yesterday. Scientists 
have declined comment on the metal from which the device 
is made. Archaeological experts from the National Museum 
have taken possession of the oddity for further study.”—Arkham 
Advertiser, June 8, 1900.
